title: Add manifest signing and delta-brief generator for onboarding
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Adds KMS-backed manifest signing and a performance-delta brief generator that auto-drafts concise release notes for model onboarding. No breaking API changes.
commits: a1b2c3d: add manifest canonicalizer and signing wrapper
d4e5f6g: implement delta brief generator and heuristic summarizer
h7i8j9k: add unit tests for signing/verification and delta scorer
l0m1n2o: CLI hook and onboarding pipeline integration
p3q4r5s: docs and changelog automation template
description:
Context and motivation: We need deterministic, auditable manifests for model onboarding so downstream systems (serving runtime, metrics, billing) can verify exactly what was shipped and automatically produce concise release notes for operators. This PR adds (1) a manifest canonicalizer + KMS-backed signer with verification utilities and (2) a delta-brief generator that ingests two manifest snapshots and produces a compact human-readable summary of metadata/versioning changes and perf-profile regressions/improvements.

What this changes (single contiguous description): Implemented a canonicalization step (stable key ordering, normalized floats/thresholds, stripping runtime-only fields) so manifests get a deterministic hash. Integrated a KMS signer abstraction (pluggable backends) and a local verification shim used by the onboarding pipeline to reject unsigned/modified manifests. Added a delta-brief generator that compares model profiles (latency p50/p95, throughput, memory/quantization footprint, eval metrics) and produces a short markdown/blurb suitable for inclusion in release notes. The generator flags significant deltas by configurable thresholds and includes guidance (rollback suggested, validate quantization profile, run canary with X% traffic).

Testing and commits: Unit tests cover canonicalization edge cases (floating noise, ordering), signing/verification, and delta heuristics. Integration tests run a sample onboarding flow: sign manifest -> push to intake -> pipeline verifies signature -> produces delta brief. Added a lightweight CLI hook (cli/onboard/manifest_sign_and_push.go) that signs manifests locally using configured KMS credentials and can operate in offline air-gapped mode with HSM-sim.

Files changed (high level): See changed_files list. Key new modules: signature_backends/kms_signer.py, ingest/manifest_canonicalizer.py, ingest/hooks/delta_brief_generator.py, and scripts/release/delta_note_autogen.py which wires brief drafts into our release automation. Small Helm values addition to enable signing validation in Private deployments.

Review notes and decisions: - Chose KMS abstraction instead of hardcoding cloud provider keys to support on-prem HSM later. - Canonicalizer intentionally strips keys with prefix "_runtime" to avoid noisy deltas. - Delta heuristic thresholds default to conservative values (5% for latency, 3% for eval accuracy) and are configurable per-model class. - No changes to the model profile schema contract; we normalize/preserve existing fields so this is backwards-compatible.

CI and rollout: Initial CI discovered an intermittent e2e failure in the CLI sign flow (timeout acquiring mock KMS). Fixed by adding retry/backoff and a test fixture. Full CI now green: unit, integration, lint, and signed-workflow. Rollout plan: merge to main, enable pipeline verification by default in a feature-flagged manner for 2 weeks (so we can monitor false positives), then flip enforcement.

Review conversation (excerpt compressed into single string): Reviewer Liam Chen: "Nice separation of concerns — can we avoid keeping private keys in local test fixtures?" Author (Sofia): "Switched tests to use ephemeral in-memory KMS mock and removed persistent test keys; added docs for secure local dev." Reviewer Priya Raman: "Delta thresholds OK, but add a note on how teams tune thresholds per workload." Author: "Added docs + per-model config + examples in docs/onboarding/manifest-signing.md" Reviewer Marco Alvarez: "Please add telemetry for rejection reasons when verification fails so support can triage." Author: "Added a telemetry event (registry.onboard.signature_reject_reason) and included it in tests." Final approval: Liam/ Priya/ Marco approved.

Merge outcome: Merged via squash on 2024-11-12 by Sofia Martinez. Changelog: automated brief drafts will be emitted to the release draft pipeline; ops will be notified via Slack digest for first two weeks.

Notes for QA and SRE: - Monitor registry.onboard.signature_reject_rate and delta_brief.alerts for spike during rollout. - Validate that canonicalization does not change existing manifest hashes for older entries (we run a backfill comparator job in background). - If teams need immediate rollback path, set the feature flag to permissive for the affected org id.

Related work: ENG-9721 (onboard artifact provenance), PM-412 (release note automation).
